chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani narrated to us, he said: al-Mundhir ibn Muhammad informed us, he said: Ja'far ibn Sulayman narrated to us from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from Sa'd ibn Turayf, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said in one of his sermons: O people! Listen to my words and reflect upon them from me, for indeed the separation is near.

I am the Imam of humanity, the deputy of the best of creation, the husband of the Mistress of the Women of this Nation, and the father of the pure progeny and the guiding Imams. I am the brother of the Messenger of God, his deputy, his guardian, his vizier, his companion, his chosen one, his beloved, and his intimate friend. I am the Commander of the Faithful, the leader of the radiant and distinguished believers, and the master of the successors.

My war is the war of God, and my peace is the peace of God. Obedience to me is obedience to God, my authority is the authority of God, my followers are the friends of God, and my supporters are the supporters of God.

By Him who created me when I was nothing, the preservers among the companions of Muhammad (may God bless him and his family) know that the oath-breakers, the deviators, and the apostates are cursed upon the tongue of the unlettered Prophet; and indeed, those who fabricated lies have failed.

key_terms.البرية: Humanity, all of creation -- emphasizing his universal Imamate
key_terms.العترة الطاهرة: The Pure Progeny, referring to the Ahlulbayt purified by Quran 33:33
key_terms.الغر المحجلين: The radiant and distinguished ones, those with shining foreheads and limbs on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.القاسطين: The deviators/unjust, referring to Muawiya and his faction at Siffin
key_terms.المارقين: The apostates, the Kharijites who left the faith like an arrow leaves the bow
key_terms.المستحفظون: The preservers, the trusted companions who memorized the Prophet's teachings
key_terms.الناكثين: The oath-breakers, those who broke their allegiance to Ali at the Battle of Jamal

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his ranks and the cursing of the Nakithun, Qasitun and Mariqun?
ai.summary: In this powerful sermon delivered near the end of his life, Imam Ali (AS) declared his divinely appointed ranks and titles before the people, including being the Imam of humanity, the Prophet's deputy, brother, and successor, and the father of the purified Ahlulbayt. Addressing an audience familiar with the Prophet's declarations at Ghadir Khumm and elsewhere, he affirmed that the three groups who opposed him -- the Nakithun (oath-breakers of the Battle of Jamal), the Qasitun (deviators at Siffin), and the Mariqun (Kharijites) -- were cursed by the Prophet himself. The phrase 'the separation is near' signals his awareness of his impending martyrdom.
